title: PD-control construct check using the locked three-axis peak-velocity pipeline
timing: Specified after review of the locked primary results and editorial feedback.

population.PD: WearGait-PD Version 1 participants with a valid bilateral SelfPace_matTURN recording and complete age, sex, and height covariates.
population.control: WearGait-PD Version 1 controls with a valid bilateral SelfPace_matTURN recording and complete age, sex, and height covariates.

shared_task_rationale: SelfPace_matTURN is the only standard-pace walking task available for both groups. The locked task model found no material difference between SelfPace_matTURN and standard SelfPace walking for the primary sensor outcome (FDR p=.703).
pipeline: Apply the unmodified locked run_locked_analysis.py three-axis low-pass, PCA projection, swing-detection, and median peak angular-velocity extraction to each wrist. No task-, axis-, or threshold-selection is based on this comparison.
outcomes: Absolute log right-to-left ratio of median peak angular velocity (primary construct check).
Bilateral mean of median arm-swing amplitude in degrees (supportive expected group-difference check).
estimands: Unadjusted standardized mean difference (PD minus control).
Age-, sex-, and height-adjusted PD group coefficient and two-sided p value from ordinary least squares.
claim_boundary: Supportive same-dataset construct evidence only. It does not validate individual clinical-side classification, establish external validation, alter the locked primary estimand, or rescue a null result.
reporting: Report both the asymmetry and amplitude outcomes, including any null result, and label all estimates post-result exploratory.
